name: high-risk-task-waits-for-running-plan-review
goal: A `t3` task waits (`plan_review`) while a plan review covering its generation runs. Today a t3 task added after that review started, which no review covers yet, dispatches at once; make it wait for the running review too, so it starts only after its own review ends. A lead claiming a `direct` t3 task while such a review runs must get `invalid_state` with a message naming `plan review <review id>`.
